name: CredCore - Tusk Liquid
description: Tusk Liquid connects AI assistants to CredCore's curated database of public credit-agreement data — covenants, debt structure, pricing, amendments, and obligations — extracted from publicly filed credit agreements. Once connected, you can query a deal's terms, benchmark covenant packages against market comps, track changes across amendments, and compare a borrower with its peers; the assistant retrieves the values and composes the answer. Coverage spans thousands of agreements across sectors, structures, and lenders. Built for leveraged-finance, private-credit, CLO, DCM, and legal teams. Read-only and informational only — not legal, lending, investment, or underwriting advice.

_published_faq.name: How do I add CredCore - Tusk Liquid to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add CredCore - Tusk Liquid to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.credcore.com/liquid-mcp/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the CredCore - Tusk Liquid MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: CredCore - Tusk Liquid provides these MCP tools: lookup_columns, query_sql, and search_values.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to CredCore - Tusk Liquid?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to CredCore - Tusk Liquid in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.

_published_faq.name: Does CredCore - Tusk Liquid MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: CredCore - Tusk Liquid requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
CredCore - Tusk Liquid is developed by CredCore Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
